description: Approved temporary dependency vulnerability exceptions for CircleSfera. Each exception must include a package name, advisory/CVE identifier, severity, justification, runtime mitigation, expiration date, and approving owner.

exceptions.reason: GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp (http-cache-semantics <=4.2.0, max-stale handling can disclose cross-user cached responses). No patched release exists (4.2.0 is the latest). It reaches the backend only through the devDependency @swc/cli (build-time compiler) -> @xhmikosr/bin-wrapper -> @xhmikosr/downloader -> got -> cacheable-request, which downloads compiler binaries during install. That path handles no user data and no shared cache across users.
exceptions.mitigation: Not shipped: the production backend image installs with npm ci --omit=dev, so none of these packages are in the running service. Remove this exception as soon as a fixed http-cache-semantics or an updated @swc/cli chain is published.
